about: The name of a season's pill from the name Jellyfin gives it (Windows and Mac EpisodePages.Named, iPhone SeasonNames.label). Each case: what it is, the season number, Jellyfin's name, then the pill in French and in English, and the series' name when the case needs it; null = Mira's own « Saison N » / « Season N ».
